correctness.rationale: For W_{q,n}=K1∨n K_{q-1} (q>=3,n>=2), no outer uncolored vertex can be forced before the hub receives a color, and no blade with >=2 originally uncolored outer vertices can subsequently be completed. Hence every blade initially seeds >=q-2 vertices; a hub-free start additionally requires all q-1 nonhub colors on seeded outer vertices, otherwise there is no legal first move. For a fixed proper coloring each blade contributes z^{q-2}(q-1+z), hub seeded adds z, and the hub-free failure event consists exactly of q-1 common omitted colors. Unique forced full extension prevents overcounting. Multiplying by q((q-1)!)^n gives the exact polynomial, minimum-size coefficient and probability formula for 0<=p<=1/q. Direct original-rule brute force independently matched q=3,n=2,3 and q=4,n=2, while structural counting proves all parameters.
